openQuestions.question: Possible stillness nondeterminism at sdsj on pixel7: in one full local run (two workers, 30 min) exhibit-contract saw the sdsj canvas change between two captures 3 s apart under ?test=1. The trace was overwritten before inspection; 12 targeted repeats (stats and pixel diffs every 0.5 s) and CI run 84 were all still. If it recurs in CI, an R3 or R5 owner should look for work that continues after `settled` at sdsj (late texture, bake or wing-entry glide end).
